name: Mastra
description: TypeScript agent framework with workflows, RAG and eval primitives.
descriptionZh: TypeScript Agent 框架，内置工作流、RAG 与评测原语。
license: Apache-2.0 (core); ee/ under Mastra Enterprise License
keyFact: Mastra is a TypeScript agent framework whose core is Apache-2.0, but whose ee/ directory ships under the separate Mastra Enterprise License, so it is not a purely Apache-2.0 project.
keyFactZh: Mastra 是 TypeScript Agent 框架，其核心为 Apache-2.0，但 ee/ 目录采用单独的 Mastra Enterprise License，因此并非纯 Apache-2.0 项目。
caveat: Mixed licensing: production commercial use of the ee/ enterprise directory requires a Mastra license. GitHub reports the repository license as NOASSERTION for this reason.
caveatZh: 许可混合：若生产环境商用 ee/ 企业目录，需获得 Mastra 授权。正因如此，GitHub 将该仓库许可证标记为 NOASSERTION。
